items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover and arbitrary code execution. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could be leveraged to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without authentication, allowing attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Auth Bypass) Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application. This vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: SessionReaper: Improper Input Validation leading to Security Feature Bypass (Account Takeover/RCE)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.
